mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment(id,order_id,payment_key,amount,status,method,entitlement_status,failure_code,approved_at,canceled_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{orderId},#{paymentKey},#{amount},#{status},#{method},#{entitlementStatus},#{failureCode},#{approvedAt},#{canceledAt},#{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT(order_id) DO UPDATE SET payment_key=EXCLUDED.payment_key,status=EXCLUDED.status,method=EXCLUDED.method,entitlement_status=EXCLUDED.entitlement_status,failure_code=EXCLUDED.failure_code,approved_at=EXCLUDED.approved_at,canceled_at=EXCLUDED.canceled_at,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
